rationale: Well-documented 4-patient dermatology case series with clear psoriasis/GPP diagnoses (PASI), per-case demographics, and detailed perioperative TNF-blocker timing and outcomes, limited by unclear consecutive and complete inclusion (selection bias) and only one orthopaedic case (Achilles tendon repair); formal statistical analysis not applicable at n=4.

131-patient multicenter case series with clear inclusion, PASI-based condition measurement, and continuation-versus-discontinuation PASI/infection outcomes reported by arm, limited by unclear consecutive/complete inclusion, no isolated orthopaedic denominator (2 knee-arthroplasty infections pooled within 58 major-surgery cases), and a minor internal inconsistency (text says the 87 continuers had no complications whereas Table 2 credits the continuation arm with one wound infection).

High-quality single-patient case report (PsA bilateral high tibial osteotomy with adalimumab held 2 weeks pre-operatively) with complete demographics, a clear multi-year timeline, extensive diagnostics (radiographs, MRI, DAPSA, arthroscopy), described intervention, 2-year outcomes (KOOS/ROM improvement), explicit absence of wound infection or psoriasis flare, and clear takeaway lessons; all 8 items met.

Adequate letter-format case report of infliximab continued through hand surgery (thumb fusion, contracture release) in PsA mutilans with clear demographics, history, diagnostics, and an infection-free, function-improved outcome, limited by brevity and vague perioperative drug timing (no explicit last-dose-to-surgery interval, only 'under regular infliximab treatment'), scored Unclear on clarity of the intervention/drug-management description.
